status: prespecified before any test-set extraction or evaluation; later changes only as dated addenda in docs/protocol.md
question: How well do a rules/regex baseline and a quote-grounded LLM extractor agree with curated TCGA clinical fields when extracting a fixed schema from OCR'd TCGA-BRCA pathology reports?
framing: Agreement with curated fields, not accuracy. Curated values may come from documents other than the OCR'd report (addenda, separate IHC/FISH reports, later surgery), so disagreement is not necessarily extractor error.

cohort.source: TCGA-Reports (Kefeli & Tatonetti 2024) BRCA reports joined to UCSC Xena TCGA.BRCA.sampleMap/BRCA_clinicalMatrix

split.rule: sort unique patient IDs by SHA256(patient_id|pathology-extraction-v1); first round(0.25*n) are test; no outcome or label is read
split.use: dev for rule/prompt iteration; test extracted and evaluated once after the freeze commit

llm_dev_sample.rule: sort dev patient IDs by SHA256(patient_id|pathology-extraction-llm-dev-v1); first 80

curated_mapping.er_status/pr_status: Positive->positive, Negative->negative; Indeterminate, [Not Available], missing -> excluded from that field
curated_mapping.histologic_type: Infiltrating Ductal->ductal; Infiltrating Lobular->lobular; Mucinous->mucinous; Mixed Histology or Other with histological_type_other mentioning both ductal and lobular->mixed_ductal_lobular; all else (metaplastic, medullary, NOS, other)->other
curated_mapping.pathologic_t: main AJCC category: leading T1-T4 or TX (T1c->T1, T4b->T4)
curated_mapping.pathologic_n: main AJCC category: N0-N3 or NX (N0 (i-)/N0 (i+)->N0, N1mi/N1a->N1)
curated_mapping.laterality: anatomic_neoplasm_subdivision containing only Left -> left, only Right -> right; both or missing -> excluded
curated_mapping.patient_dedup: clinical matrix is sample-keyed; the curated columns are asserted identical across a patient's sample rows; one row per patient kept

rules.description: hand-written regular expressions, first-match or simple vote/sum heuristics, exact matched substring as evidence

gpt-4.1.deployment: gpt-4.1 (model gpt-4.1-2025-04-14) on a personal Azure OpenAI resource

llm_settings.auth: short-lived Azure CLI bearer token, subscription passed explicitly, no API key

grounding.rule: every non-not_stated value needs >=1 quote; each quote must occur in the report exactly or after collapsing whitespace runs to one space (no case folding, no fuzzy match); at least one quote must match the field's cue regex; count fields must have the number (digits or number word) in the quote unless several quotes are summed
grounding.failure: value replaced by an abstention with status 'rejected' (counted separately from not_stated)

metrics.eligible: per field, patients whose curated value is available
metrics.agreement_e2e: PRIMARY per-field metric: agreeing answers / eligible; not_stated and rejected count as non-agreement
metrics.agreement_answered: agreeing answers / answered eligible (secondary; read together with coverage)
metrics.coverage: answered / eligible; also n_not_stated and n_rejected
metrics.kappa: unweighted Cohen's kappa between curated and extracted values over answered eligible patients (categorical fields only)
metrics.macro: unweighted mean over fields of per-field agreement_e2e

primary_comparison.estimand: macro agreement_e2e over the 10 categorical fields, gpt-4.1 minus rules, test set
primary_comparison.ci: paired patient bootstrap, resample test patients with replacement, B=2000, seed=20261120, percentile 95% CI
primary_comparison.decision: LLM has higher agreement with curated fields if the 95% CI lower bound > 0; lower if upper bound < 0; otherwise inconclusive

secondary_comparisons: per-field paired bootstrap CIs for agreement_e2e differences (descriptive, no multiplicity correction)

consistency_checks.note: cross-field consistency checks, not relation extraction; reported as violation rates among patients where both fields are answered, for each extractor and for curated values
consistency_checks.pn_vs_positive_count: pathologic_n equals AJCC bucket of ln_positive (0->N0, 1-3->N1, 4-9->N2, >=10->N3); excludes NX; known legitimate exceptions: micrometastases/ITC, IHC-only nodes, internal mammary/supraclavicular nodes, neoadjuvant setting

adjudication_sample.population: test patients x fields where gpt-4.1 or rules answered a value that differs from the curated value
adjudication_sample.stratification: round-robin over fields (shuffled within field, seed 20261120)
adjudication_sample.content: curated value, rules value+quote, gpt-4.1 value+quote, gpt-4o value+quote, report context window
adjudication_sample.status: UNREVIEWED until Lu completes it; nothing is called validated before then

error_sources: heuristic tags on all test disagreements (missing_in_report, multiple_specimens_or_sides, ocr_noise_in_evidence, extractors_conflict, curated_vs_report_conflict); tags are automatic and unadjudicated

cost.price_source: Azure OpenAI list prices (global standard) as published at the time; actual billing not checked
cost.reported: per-report input/output tokens, latency, USD (mean, median, p95) per model on the test set
cost.budget: total LLM spend < USD 10; gpt-4.1 on the 80-patient dev sample (iteration) and on all 258 test reports; gpt-4o on all 258 test reports only; responses cached to results/cache/llm_cache.jsonl

failed_calls: API errors are retried up to 8 times; a report whose call still fails is re-run until success; a non-'stop' finish or invalid JSON makes every field 'rejected' for that report
